page_title: WER 2-0 EIN | Werder Bremen v Eintracht Frankfurt 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The attendance is 42100.
90+2' Substitution. Romano Schmid is replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
89' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
87' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Senne Lynen is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:0.
82' Here's the change. Mario Gotze leaves the pitch and Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
81' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
79' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
79' Felix Agu tees up Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just over the bar.
78' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is able to continue to play.
76' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' That was close by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
74' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
72' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
70' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Hugo Larsson will be replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
70' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
67' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
66' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Werder Bremen are awarded the free kick.
66' Here comes a substitution. Marvin Ducksch is given a rest as he is replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
65' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) replaces Oliver Burke.
65' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Anthony Jung.
64' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nnamdi Collins as he is replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt).
63' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
62' A clumsy foul by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.
61' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
60' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) duly receives a yellow card.
59' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the free kick from the edge of the box. His decent attempt goes narrowly wide of the left post.

58' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
57' A pass lands at the feet of Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
53' The resulting corner from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is cleared by the defence.
52' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle as Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
49' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
47' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
46' Dino Toppmoller makes a half-time substitution. Michy Batshuayi comes on in place of Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The whistle blows and Daniel Siebert starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The referee is firm and issues Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) a deserved yellow card.
45+1' The corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is hurriedly cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
44' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
44' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
42' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Kaua Santos.
39' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Kaua Santos comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. This is a yellow card! Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
34' Werder Bremen couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
32' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michael Zetterer intercepts the ball.
30' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

28' 1 - 0 Romano Schmid takes over corner duties and expertly finds Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen), who scores with a header that bounces up off the ground and goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
28' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
25' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the crossbar. What a great chance!
25' Corner kicks – 2:5.
21' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
21' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the corner.
20' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
17' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
17' The corner from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
16' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.

15' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) receives the ball and fires a first-time shot from long range. His brilliant effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Kaua Santos, who pulls off a stunning save!
13' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends it out of play.
12' The ball is cleared after Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
10' The corner from Marvin Ducksch evades the keeper, but Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar.
10' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
10' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
9' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a throw-in.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
8' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.
5' Eintracht Frankfurt are ruled offside.
3' The resulting corner from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
3' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Werder Bremen have a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
Daniel Siebert is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
